legend: Rare small tissue fragments are present, with abundant chromatinic streaking artefact and some single rounded intact tumour cells with fragile cytoplasm (Giemsa).

High-power magnification of cell block, highlighting discohesive tumour cells with round to oval, moderately pleomorphic nuclei with nuclear irregularities, vesicular chromatin, and prominent nucleoli. Many tumour cells display eccentric dense eosinophilic cytoplasm, but classic rhabdoid morphology is not seen (H&E).
Cell block ICC for SMARCA4 (BRG1) shows complete loss of expression of SMARCA4 in tumour cells, in the presence of a positive internal control demonstrated by nuclear positivity in benign cells.
ICC for SMARCA2 (BRM) on cell block material shows complete loss of expression of SMARCA2 in tumour cells, in the presence of a positive internal control (nuclear positivity in benign cells).

Highly pleomorphic dispersed tumour cells with eccentric cytoplasm in most cells, with cytoplasmic densities pushing into the curved nucleus of some cells, and hyperchromatic coarse chromatin with perinucleolar clearing and large nucleoli; occasional giant cells with large highly pleomorphic nuclei are seen (Pap).
Highly pleomorphic tumour cells with eccentric cytoplasm (in most cells) and highly pleomorphic nuclei with coarse chromatin and prominent nucleoli (Pap).
